import json

from django.test import TestCase
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from api.models import Problem, User
from api.views import ProblemViewSet, UserViewSet


class TestProblemViewSet(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.client = APIClient()

    def test_get_problems(self):
        url = '/api/problems/'
        data = {'name': 'test_name',
                'description': 'test_description'}

        # Create a user
        user = User.objects.create_user('user_name', '', '')

        # Create a problem
        problem = Problem.objects.create(name=data['name'],
                                         description=data['description'],
                                         owner=user)

        # Create a second user
        user = User.objects.create_user('user_name', '', '')

        # Create a second problem
        problem = Problem.objects.create(name=data['name'],
                                         description=data['description'],
                                         owner=user)

        response = self.client.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(json.loads(response.content)), 2)

    def test_create_problem(self):
        url = '/api/problems/'
        data = {'name': 'test_name',
                'description': 'test_description'}

        # Create a user
        user = User.objects.create_user('user_name', '', '')

        # Create a problem
        response = self.client.post(url, data)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 201)

        response = self.client.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(json.loads(response.content)), 1)
